name: tr_horford
caption:
IF HORFORD HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐊 Feraligatr: its huge jaws intimidate foes. NCAA champion at Florida in 2006 and 2007
🦅 Talonflame: it dives on its prey at blazing speed. #3 pick to Atlanta in 2007
⭐ Jirachi: legend says it grants any wish. 5-time All-Star
⏳ Celebi: it wanders across time. 186 playoff games before his first ring, an NBA record
💥 Clawitzer: its claw is a water cannon. 40.7% from three in his first 9 games
🐘 Copperajah: its trunk crushes giant rocks to powder. Big Al, 40 years old, back for season 20

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Al Horford had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF HORFORD HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Feraligatr. It opens its huge jaws to intimidate its foes. Back-to-back national titles at Florida.
beats.dlg: ITS HUGE JAWS INTIMIDATE.|NCAA CHAMP 2006 AND 2007!

beats.vo: Talonflame. A fiery bird that dives on its prey at blazing speed. Atlanta took him third overall in two thousand seven.
beats.dlg: DIVES IN AT BLAZING SPEED.|#3 PICK TO ATLANTA, 2007!

beats.vo: Jirachi. Legend says it grants any wish written on the notes on its head. Five-time All-Star.
Celebi. It wanders across time. One hundred eighty-six playoff games before his first ring. An NBA record.
beats.dlg: IT WANDERS ACROSS TIME.|RING IN PLAYOFF GAME 186!

beats.vo: Clawitzer. Its claw is a cannon that fires water hard enough to sink a tanker. Forty point seven percent from three off our bench in his first nine games.
beats.dlg: ITS CLAW IS A CANNON.|40.7% FROM THREE!

beats.vo: And the ace. Copperajah. Its trunk can crush giant rocks into powder. Big Al. Forty years old, and back with us for season twenty.
beats.dlg: ITS TRUNK CRUSHES ROCKS.|BIG AL, 40: SEASON 20!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Horford, nicknamed Big Al, born June 3, 1986 (age 40); 2x NCAA champion at Florida (2006, 2007); drafted 3rd overall (#3) in 2007 by Atlanta; 5x All-Star; first NBA championship in 2024 in his 186th career playoff game, the record for most playoff games before a championship; re-signed with Golden State June 25, 2026 to play his 20th season
